name: bysound-examples
description: Runnable examples for bysound. They import ../web/src directly and use web/'s toolchain: run `npm ci` in ../web once.

scripts.build:web: for d in web-wifi-setup web-channel-ladder; do ../web/node_modules/.bin/vite build $d -c vite.config.ts || exit 1; done && ../web/node_modules/.bin/vite build store-presence -c store-presence/vite.config.ts
